title: Define buckleup template specifications
description:
## Summary
Further specify and refine the buckleup project scaffolding template. Define detailed requirements for each generated component, establish conventions, and document what the template should produce.

## Context
Initial implementation is complete with justfile, mdbook, markdown linting, pre-commit hooks, GitHub Actions, and AGENTS.md templates. Need to review and refine the specifics of what gets generated.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Template specifications documented
- [ ] All generated files reviewed for completeness
- [ ] Conventions finalized and documented
